general_a1: Premier Health Clinic is a leading luxury wellness and healthcare destination specializing in IV Drip Therapy, dermatology, and aesthetic treatments. Founded in 2018 in Cairo, we have expanded across Egypt and into the UAE.
general_a2: We currently operate at Fairmont Nile City (Cairo), EDNC Sodic (New Cairo), Arkan Plaza (Sheikh Zayed, Giza), and Dubai Marina (UAE).
general_q3: How do I book an appointment?
general_a3: You can book online through our website's book appointment page, call us on +20 120 064 4663, or visit any of our branches directly.
ivDrips_a1: Yes. All IV drips are administered by certified medical professionals in sterile, clinically-approved settings. Each session is preceded by a doctor consultation and vital signs check.
ivDrips_q2: How long does an IV session take?
ivDrips_a2: Sessions typically range from 45 minutes to 2 hours depending on the drip type. NAD+ drips take longer (90-120 minutes), while hydration drips take only 45 minutes.
ivDrips_q3: What is the difference between oral supplements and IV therapy?
ivDrips_a3: IV therapy bypasses the digestive system, delivering nutrients directly into the bloodstream for 100% absorption — versus 30% or less for oral supplements.
derma_q1: How many HydraFacial sessions do I need?
derma_a1: For optimal results, we recommend an initial series of 3-4 sessions spaced 2-3 weeks apart, followed by monthly maintenance sessions.
derma_q2: What is the downtime for Botox and fillers?
derma_a2: Botox and fillers have minimal downtime — typically 24-48 hours of mild swelling or redness. Patients can resume normal activities the same day.
billing_q1: Can I cancel or reschedule my appointment?
billing_a1: Yes, you can cancel or reschedule up to 24 hours before your appointment at no extra charge by contacting our team via phone or through the online portal.
billing_q2: What payment methods do you accept?
billing_a2: We accept cash, credit/debit cards, medical insurance (selected plans), and online payment via Paymob.
